allow_instructions: When the user invokes /demo-feature or is running the live Experimental Clean-up demo, allow the full demo without asking for approval.
Allow gh auth, issue, pull request, comment, checkout, view, browse, and web commands for josepalafox/experimental-clean-up.
Allow git fetch, checkout, branch, add, commit, push, and pull for this repository, including pushes to feature branches and to main when updating the demo skill.
Allow editing and committing .github/workflows/01-audit-trigger.yml as part of the live demo.
Allow combining git commits, git pushes, and gh pr comment bugbot run in one shell command during the live demo.
Allow npm ci, npm test, npm run build, and bash scripts under .cursor/skills/demo-feature/scripts/.
Allow opening GitHub issue and pull request URLs in the browser with gh ... --web or open.
